subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If an effective native mapping or qualification is missing, malformed, incompatible, weakening, injected, or unable to satisfy the task profile, then the system shall apply FR-24 and stop before any claim or worker invocation; before coordinated parent activation, retain the existing zero-network refusal-evidence path; after activation, append and exact-read EVT-8 through the canonical git evidence store before reporting the refusal; if append or exact-read fails, assert no verified canonical EVT-8, report a routing-evidence-admission failure, leave the task unclaimed and retryable, and perform no other inference or network operation
intent: named policy-invalid or unsupported result with selected harness and unmet components, or after activation a named evidence-admission failure with the task and attempted terminal identity
fit_criterion: before parent activation every trigger records its refusal with zero claims/invocations and zero network I/O; after activation, with a healthy evidence store every trigger records exactly one verified EVT-8 before refusal, performs zero claims/invocations and no harness substitution, and records no network activity except canonical append/exact-read; append-failure and exact-read-failure fixtures assert no verified canonical EVT-8, produce zero claims/invocations, expose the named evidence-admission failure, and leave the task retryable; a successful retry appends exactly one immutable EVT-8; independent satisfiable tasks may continue
